title: Gearium
description: A high performance Minecraft modpack optimized for smooth gameplay, fast loading, and reduced lag. Perfect for players seeking maximum FPS and stability without sacrificing essential features.
body:
A simple minecraft ModPack focusing on performance.

### Performance
Gearium is designed to be faster than all clients, thanks to modern performance mods, such as Sodium, Lithium, and others.

### Works Everywhere
Gearium is tweaked with percision to allow you to experience minecraft just as you know it, no matter what version you've used before. This means you can play singleplayer, multiplayer wherever you want just as vanilla minecraft.

### Built on Fabric
Gearium uses the fabric Mod Loader, which is lightweight fast and supports alot of mods, you can use this modpack as a base to add your favoirite mods to.

### Up To Date
Gearium recieves fast updates ensuring you are always on the latest version of minecraft.

## Included Mods:
Performance & Optimization: Lithium, FerriteCore, C2ME, Sodium, Sodium Extra, Reeses Sodium Options, ModernFix, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, ImmediatelyFast


### Graphics & Visuals: 
Iris, Continuity, Bobby, Noxesium, BadOptimizations


### Utility & Configuration:
ModMenu, Cloth Config, Yet Another Config Lib, Malilib, Placeholder API, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin

### Additional Enhancements: 
BBE, Debugify, Durability Tooltip, Krypton, Fast IP Ping
